```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  function initBoard() {
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.bp-card');

    cards.forEach(function(card) {
      var btn   = card.querySelector('.bp-toggle');
      var ctrlId = btn ? btn.getAttribute('aria-controls') : null;
      var detail = ctrlId ? document.getElementById(ctrlId) : null;

      if (!btn || !detail) return;

      function openCard() {
        detail.removeAttribute('hidden');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        card.classList.add('bp-is-open');
      }

      function closeCard() {
        detail.setAttribute('hidden', '');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        card.classList.remove('bp-is-open');
      }

      function toggleCard() {
        if (card.classList.contains('bp-is-open')) {
          closeCard();
        } else {
          // close all others
          cards.forEach(function(c) {
            var ob = c.querySelector('.bp-toggle');
            var oid = ob ? ob.getAttribute('aria-controls') : null;
            var od  = oid ? document.getElementById(oid) : null;
            if (od) { od.setAttribute('hidden', ''); }
            if (ob) { ob.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
            c.classList.remove('bp-is-open');
          });
          openCard();
        }
      }

      btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        toggleCard();
      });

      card.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && e.target === card) {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggleCard();
        }
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!e.target.closest('.bp-card')) {
        cards.forEach(function(c) {
          var ob = c.querySelector('.bp-toggle');
          var oid = ob ? ob.getAttribute('aria-controls') : null;
          var od  = oid ? document.getElementById(oid) : null;
          if (od) { od.setAttribute('hidden', ''); }
          if (ob) { ob.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
          c.classList.remove('bp-is-open');
        });
      }
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initBoard);
  } else {
    initBoard();
  }
})();
</script>
```
